incidents.name: SNK minter reward calculation error
incidents.notes: The SNK minter multiplies a parent account's rewardPerToken by the summed balances of all its children, so stacking referral children multiplied the mintable SNK, which the attacker sold into the BUSD pool.

sources.ref: onchain review: SNK minter 0xA3f5ea945c4970f48E322f1e70F4CC08e70039ee created 2022-12-27T15:55:14Z by 0x040e73929ee1db37b5ad532a4c3bcef67a91c016, unrelated to attack sender 0x6b67f9e79180e08cb42132754bc9f88558b1e535; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 197,725.73 USDT left the SNK pool 0x7957096Bd7324357172B765C4b0996Bb164ebfd4 in this transaction (the earlier 0xace1129259... transaction only set the position up).
